title: 3 ways machines learn
label: EP 24
banner: 3 ways AI learns, just like you

lines.text: ChatGPT learned in three completely different ways. [1] And you've used all three... [2] since you were five. [3] With a teacher... [4] on your own... [5] and by trial and error.

Way one: tuition class. [1] The teacher gives you questions... [2] with the answers. [3] That's supervised learning. [4] You show the AI thousands of examples, each with the right answer, [5] called a label. [6] Spam, or not spam. [7] Cat, or dog. [8] Then it answers new ones on its own.

Way two: a messy cupboard... [1] and nobody tells you where anything goes. [2] You still end up with neat piles. [3] Shirts. [4] Socks. [5] Books. [6] That's unsupervised learning. [7] No answers at all. The AI finds natural groups on its own. [8] Like a shop discovering its fitness buyers... [9] and suggesting sports gear to the next one.

Way three: learning to ride a cycle. [1] Fall... and it hurts. [2] Balance... and you fly. [3] That's reinforcement learning. [4] Try something, get a reward or a penalty, and try again. [5] Game AIs, robots, even self-driving cars learn this way.

data.question: A robot learns to walk by falling and earning points for every step. Which type?

lines.text: Quick test! A robot learns to walk by falling... and earning points for every step. [1] Which type of learning is that? <pause 2> [2] Reinforcement learning! Trial, error, and rewards.

lines.text: So... [1] learning with answers is supervised. [2] Finding groups alone is unsupervised. [3] Trial and error is reinforcement. [4] And ChatGPT? It used all three. [5] Next up: why data is the real fuel of AI. Follow, so you don't miss it.
